name: Alesya: Pobeg iz lagerya V2
source:
The story takes place in the 80s. Due to a questionable action, the protagonist and his friend end up in the Sovyonok camp as a punishment.
The protagonist is a chronic loser, an ever-optimistic guy, an intellectual by nature, and a rebel inside, but his friend is his exact opposite. In the camp, he will get to know a new character, Alesya, the second camp counselor's assistant.
The protagonists oppose the protagonist of the original story, Semyon.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1498012318]Steam[/url]]
